about: Analyses written by the full price check for cards that stand out (scripts/outliers.py). Shown on the card page above the automatic findings. Edit with scripts/set_insight.py.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.headline: Already corrected, now holding its floor
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/138599.text: While the My-tier index fell about 8% over the past week, the lowest ask barely moved (¥29,800 → ¥29,999) and sales actually firmed: the last 10 one-copy sales have a median of ¥29,780, about 10% above the 10 before them (¥27,000). The likely reason is that this card corrected earlier and harder than the rest of the tier: it is 59% below its May peak (Umbreon is about 37% below its peak), so it is already back in its pre-hype range, where buyers step in. Nothing outside the page points the other way: searches found no news of a VMAX Climax reprint or a new product reprinting this card. The caveat is a thin order book (6 of 20 listings within 15% of the lowest) and only about 1.6 sales a day, so a couple of cheap listings could still pull it down. For you: it sits right on the Buy line (¥29,500), and a dip to your ¥26,000 limit is less likely while it holds up (the model says about 30% within 30 days). Watch whether sales stay around ¥29–30k if the market keeps falling.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/387059.headline: Rising on Gengar attention from the 30th set, but the burst is fading
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/387059.text: The lowest ask rose from ¥41,000 to ¥43,000 over the week while the My-tier index fell about 8%, and sales rose with it (¥40,000–41,000 on 9/19–22, ¥43,000–43,500 since 9/25). The likely driver is attention on Gengar: the 30th CELEBRATION set released on 9/16 has three Gengar cards, a Gengar ex RR, a Gengar ex SAR and a special reprint of the classic Gengar (per torecolle, 9/18), and collectors of a character often look at its older cards too. That spillover is already fading: about 2.4 PSA10 sales a day now against roughly 7.5 a week ago. At ¥43,000 it is in the Watch zone (Buy ≤¥38,000), 23% above your ¥35,000 limit and 22% below its August peak (¥55,000). With buying slowing, the higher price needs new buyers to hold, so a slide back toward ¥40–41k would not be surprising. It also remains outside your collecting criteria (SM era, not full art); the new Gengar ex SAR is the natural replacement once its PSA10 market forms.

https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/585221.headline: Asks dropped below where it sells; plenty of supply behind it
https://snkrdunk.com/apparels/585221.text: The cheapest listing fell from ¥117,900 yesterday to ¥108,000 today, about 10% below recent sale prices (most sales from 9/21 to 9/25 were ¥116,000–120,000, one at ¥125,000 a day ago). The order book is deep, with all 20 sampled listings within 15% of the lowest, so this is sellers lowering prices across the board rather than one stray listing. There is a lot of supply behind the card: White Flare (June 2025) got an official additional production run and was restocked at many retailers through autumn 2025 (per SNKRDUNK's reprint tracker), which keeps new raw copies flowing into grading; searches found no news of a further reprint in 2026. So sale prices likely follow the asks down with the market correction rather than this being a one-off bargain. ¥108,000 is exactly its Buy line, but the correction rule keeps it at Watch; the next checks will show whether sales happen near ¥108–110k. Your ¥70,000 limit remains far below.
